title: Blow-ups at a good point converge to a constant-orientation cycle with the integer slice property
statement: Hypothesis names: (REP), (MR), (SL) are the exact frozen statements of the DAG theorems cmc_exists_massRepresentation, cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure, cmc_slice_mass_bounds (hypotheses of the selected parent cbr_cycle_isIntegerMultiplicity); (RU) is the exact frozen statement of the sibling cbr_setIntegral_eq_of_integral_eq, (CT) = (T1) ∧ (T2) ∧ (MM) that of cbr_measure_convergence_tools, (RECT) that of cbr_rectifiable_of_approx_tangent; whichever are needed appear verbatim as hypotheses of the Lean statement. In words: (REP) a current T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), U open, with M_W(T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U has a mass representation (μ, ξ): μ(ℝ^P∖U) = 0, μ(K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U, μ(W) = M_W(T) for open W, ξ μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α, T(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ, and μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0 provided also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U; (MR) M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for an IMRep R of T in an open U and open W; (SL) for T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U) with admissible representations (μ, ξ) of T and (μ', ξ') of ∂T and L-Lipschitz f there are currents A_t, B_t with A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ, B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'(η)dμ', ∂A_t = B_t on forms supported off {f = t}, M_W(∂A_t − B_t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0}h⁻¹μ(W ∩ {t−h < f < t}) and ∫_a^b M_W(∂A_t − B_t)dt ≤ Lμ(W ∩ {a < f < b}) for open W; (RU) an identity ∫ξ₁(ω)dμ₁ = ∫ξ₂(ω)dμ₂ + ∫ξ₃(ω)dμ₃ between admissible pairs, valid for all test forms on an open U, remains valid with all integrals restricted to any Borel set; (T1) measures μ_j with sup_jμ_j(K) < ∞ on compacts have a subsequence converging to a Radon μ (against C_c, limsup on compacts ≤ μ, liminf on open sets ≥ μ); (T2) if X_j ⇀ X with admissible representations (μ_j, ξ_j), (μ_X, ξ_X), limsup_jμ_j(K) ≤ μ(K) on compacts, f continuous and μ{f = t} = 0, then ∫_{f<t}ξ_j(ω)dμ_j → ∫_{f<t}ξ_X(ω)dμ_X; (MM) if Z_j(t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0}h⁻¹μ_j(G ∩ {t−h < f < t}) on (a, b) then some measurable g ≥ liminf_jZ_j a.e. on (a, b) has ∫_a^b g ≤ L·liminf_jμ_j(G ∩ {a < f < b}); (RECT) a Borel M with Hⁿ(M) < ∞ having approximate tangent spaces Q(x) at Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M with x ↦ p_{Q(x)} Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable is countably n-rectifiable. Notation: Hⁿ = μHE[n], ω_n = unitBallVolume n, |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α for covectors, admissible representation (μ, ξ) of a current X in ℝ^P: μ Borel, finite on compact sets, ξ μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| μ-a.e., X(ω) = ∫ξ(x)(ω(x))dμ(x) for every test form. ISP (integer slice property) of Y ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P): for all admissible representations (μ, ξ) of Y and (μ', ξ') of ∂Y and every Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ, for L¹-a.e. t, all A ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P), B ∈ 𝒟_d(ℝ^P) with A(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ and B(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'(η)dμ' for all test forms have ∂A − B integer multiplicity. For a ∈ ℝ^P and λ > 0 let η(y) := dilation a λ y = λ⁻¹(y − a); X' ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) is called a dilation of X ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) if X'(ω) = λ^{−m}X(ω') for all test m-forms ω, ω' on ℝ^P with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for every y. Assume (SL), (RU), (CT). Let P, d ∈ ℕ, n := d+1, and assume SLIM_{P,d}: if X_i, X ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P), every X_i has ISP, sup_i(M_W(X_i) + M_W(∂X_i)) < ∞ for every open W with compact closure, and X_i ⇀ X, then X has ISP (the conclusion of cbr_slice_property_of_weak_limit for fixed d, P). Let Γ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with ∂Γ = 0 and ISP; μ a finite Borel measure with μ(W) = M_W(Γ) for open W; M Borel with Hⁿ(M) < ∞; θ Borel, ζ strongly measurable, μ = (Hⁿ⌞M) with density ofReal∘θ, θ > 0 on M, |ζ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α, and for each x ∈ M some β with |β| ≤ 1 and ζ(x)(β) = 1; Γ(ω) = ∫_Mθζ(ω)dHⁿ for all ω. Let a ∈ M and η₁ > 0 with liminf_{r↓0}μ(B_r(a))/(ω_nrⁿ) ≥ η₁, limsup_{r↓0}Hⁿ(M ∩ B̄_r(a))/(ω_nrⁿ) ≤ 1 and (∫⁻_{M∩B̄_r(a)}‖θζ − θ(a)ζ(a)‖dHⁿ)/(ω_nrⁿ) → 0 as r ↓ 0. Let λ_i > 0, λ_i → 0. Then there are a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ, a Borel measure ν finite on compact sets, currents C, Γ_k ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) and pairs (μ_k, ξ_k) such that, with θ₀ := θ(a) and N_k := blowUpMap a λ_{φ(k)} '' M = η_{a,λ_{φ(k)}}(M): ν(B_R(0)) ≤ ω_nRⁿ and ν(B_R(0)) > 0 for all R > 0; C(ω) = ∫θ₀ζ(a)(ω(y))dν(y), ∂C = 0, M_W(C) = θ₀ν(W) for open W, and C has ISP; Γ_k ⇀ C, ∂Γ_k = 0, μ_k finite on compacts with μ_k(W) = M_W(Γ_k) for open W, (μ_k, ξ_k) an admissible representation of Γ_k; limsup_kμ_k(K) ≤ θ₀ν(K) for compact K; μ_k(ℝ^P∖N_k) = 0; limsup_kHⁿ(N_k ∩ K) ≤ ν(K) for compact K; and ∫_{N_k}f dHⁿ → ∫f dν for every continuous compactly supported f.
